claims.text: Rapid selective formation of a protective oxide scale governs oxidation resistance in multiprincipal-element alloys.
Lattice-distortion-induced diffusion suppression governs oxidation resistance and material integrity in multiprincipal-element alloys.
The protective scale can consist of Al2O3 or an outer MnCr2O4 layer over an inner Al2O3 layer.
A refined eutectic microstructure enables rapid formation of protective Al2O3 during initial oxidation.
Cr-Co-Mn alloying and trace Y modification improve oxidation resistance in FeNiCuAl-based alloys through compositional and microstructural engineering.
Y and Hf additions produce significant lattice distortion that elevates vacancy-formation energy and Al migration barriers.
The initially formed protective oxide is thin and adherent.
The protective oxide minimizes oxygen ingress.
Lattice distortion increases the activation barrier for Al and other active-element diffusion and thereby suppresses continued elemental migration.
The combination of rapid protective-scale formation and diffusion suppression limits TGO thickening and spallation.
The dual mechanism preserves bulk mechanical integrity after extended high-temperature exposure.
Relative to a lower-distortion baseline, the proposed alloy will have a lower oxide-growth or parabolic rate constant.
Relative to the baseline, the proposed alloy will exhibit minimal TGO spallation.
Relative to the baseline, the proposed alloy will retain hardness or tensile strength better after oxidation.
Reducing Y or Hf concentration will reduce lattice distortion while otherwise providing a suitable baseline.
The lower-distortion baseline will form a less protective scale, deplete Al more quickly, and oxidize faster.
The proposed dual mechanism should be dominant at temperatures of at least approximately 1100–1200 °C when selective oxidation can begin rapidly.

If high- and low-distortion variants show similar TGO growth, oxide integrity, and mechanical retention, the claim that lattice-distortion-induced diffusion suppression is critical would be falsified.
